name: delegate
description: Start a child agent with the selected role and task. By default, wait without a deadline and return its terminal phase, or an output-bearing snapshot when an interactive child completes a turn and idles in Waiting (status=turn_completed), asks a question, or an agent message or user input arrives. Resolve questions with subagent_questions and answer_subagent_question; read messages with inbox; retrieve terminal or completed-turn results with run_output. To follow up on a finished child's work, message it instead of delegating again when run_output or wait reports continuable: it resumes with its saved context.

background.description: Return the child run_id immediately instead of waiting.

interactive.description: Keep the child available for messages after its initial turn. With background=false (default), return that turn's output when it idles; background=true returns its run_id immediately.

load_skills.description: Registered skills to load into the child.

prompt.description: Self-contained task instructions and relevant context.

anyOf.description: Implement, fix, run commands or commit; choose a category by the task's primary difficulty.

category.description: quick: bounded, well-specified mechanical work such as a typo, localized fix, or routine commit of reviewed changes with an exact staging scope; give explicit checks and forbidden actions. deep: multi-step implementation requiring codebase investigation, dependent edits, or broad verification; use high-reasoning when concurrency, invariants, or cross-process consistency is the core. high-reasoning: subtle invariants (concurrency, state shared across processes), hard debugging, or competing designs where reasoning is the bottleneck, even with few files; use deep when breadth is the main challenge. visual: UI layout, styling, design, mockups to show the user (returns artifact_id values for present), or screenshot-driven visual work; use multimodal_looker for image interpretation alone. writing: documentation, prose, or copy where audience and wording dominate. research: multi-source evidence synthesis with a worker deliverable; use explorer for read-only local code investigation and web_researcher for external source collection alone. Omit when no category fits to use the worker base binding.

anyOf.description: Independently compare implementation results or plans against requirements and give an acceptance verdict; consultation belongs to Advisor, in a separate context. Pass the requirements, the review target with its revision, and any agreed design constraints; plan-review reviews a plan before implementation and also returns agreed design constraints.

category.description: plan-review: review a plan before implementation, including design boundaries, performance premises and acceptance criteria; for an approved plan returns the agreed design constraints. Omit when no category fits to use the reviewer base binding.

anyOf.description: Create a plan through read-only investigation and return it in the final response body. Cannot create/edit files, run shell commands or delegate. Omit category; plan-review belongs to reviewer.

Read-only consultant for stepping back on a stuck decision. Pass the findings, fix history or collected evidence. It reads code and materials but runs nothing, compares design options or cause hypotheses, and returns options, trade-offs, recommendation, uncertainty, and information that would change the decision, including checks that discriminate hypotheses; when the crux is user intent, it returns a question for you to ask the user. Advice is not an acceptance verdict: use a separate context for the final independent Reviewer. oracle is a legacy alias for advisor.

Consult on agent behaviour or configuration (models, prompts, generation settings): inspect recorded threads, propose a cause and the roles to swap, and pin threads as evaluation samples. Pass the user's concern and any thread it refers to.

target.description: Select a role, then a category only if that role's branch offers one. Omission uses that role's base binding, without automatic task classification.

name: run_output
description: Read direct parent/child phase, terminal or idle-turn output and stop/failure reason, without waiting/restoring. Only status=turn_completed marks a completed interactive turn. Presenting output ACKs that child completion/generation and its automatic notice, not explicit messages; phase-only reads do not ACK. Snapshots remain readable. continuable/continuation_blocked explain whether a finished child can resume via send. Use subagent_questions for unanswered questions.

run_id.description: Runtime run ID exactly as reported, such as run-01k6z3x2q4w8e9r0t1y2u3i4o5.
